## Key Projects

### Croc OS
- ESP32-based desk companion with animated OLED face (SH1106 128x64)
- Dual N20 motors with chain tracks
- OLED face with animated expressions
- Touch sensors, WiFi, NTP time sync
- Persistent NVS storage
- Arduino/C++, Adafruit GFX, ArduinoJson

### EdgeBot (NRL 007 VoltEdge)
- Competition robot for NRL 2025 at IIT Bombay
- Mechanical lead: chassis, arm/gripper assembly, torque balancing
- Custom chassis, robotic arm + gripper assembly
- Torque-balanced drivetrain and manipulator

### Meadow
- Agent-based predator-prey ecosystem simulator
- Lotka-Volterra population dynamics
- JavaScript, Canvas rendering
- Embedded as live widget in portfolio

### Kharcha Expense Tracker
- UPI, cash, card transaction tracking
- Auto-categorization
- Donut chart visualization
- Local JSON persistence

### AI Sports Tournament Engine
- Full-stack tournament management
- Next.js, Supabase (Auth + Realtime), PostgreSQL
- Google Gemini API for AI insights
- Live scoring, standings, AI-generated insights

### Wildlife Card Game
- Flutter/Firebase Android app
- AI species identification from photos
- Collectible digital cards
- Real-world biodiversity gamification

### IoT Telemetry Dashboard
- Ground control for robotics
- 50Hz MQTT telemetry
- Live PID graphs, joystick overrides
- ESP32, Mosquitto, Node.js, InfluxDB, Next.js/Recharts

### Automatic Field Shutter + Rainwater Harvesting
- Automated agricultural shutter
- Environmental/moisture sensing
- Rainwater collection routing
- Microcontroller-based control

### Drone
- Multirotor build
- Custom airframe, motor/ESC, flight controller, radio link
- Battery power system

### 6-Wheel Moon Rover
- 6-wheel drive (6x DC geared motors)
- ESP32, OLED status display
- RF remote, WiFi/app control, line-following autonomous

### Field Shutter + Rainwater Analytics
- Batched ESP32 logging
- Pandas trend analysis
- Rainwater yield reporting
- FastAPI, Pandas, PostgreSQL, React/Chart.js

### ProjectDirec
- Robotics parts directory
- Next.js SSR, Python Scrapy, Typesense/Algolia
- Pinout diagrams, compatibility checker
- Cross-vendor price tracking
